notablePrerequisites: Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness. You control at least two mana-producing lands, one of which can produce at least {G}.
description:
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping two lands, including one that can produce {G}.
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.
